events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, first went on air on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being its inaugural music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the day music changed forever? MTV launched on this day in 1981, kicking off with The Buggles. Suddenly, the video star was born.

events.title: Oasis's Debut Album Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album, 'Definitely Maybe,' on August 29, 1994, marking a pivotal moment in Britpop history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Impact
angles.copy: On this day, we're thinking back to when Oasis dropped their iconic debut, 'Definitely Maybe,' back in '94. Still a masterpiece.

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Start
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the Woodstock Festival began. Three days of peace, love, and music that changed everything. What an era.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977, leaving an indelible mark on music and culture.

angles.name: Elvis Remembrance
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll through the decades.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur's Legacy
events.blurb: Legendary rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and later died from his injuries on September 13, 1996, leaving a profound impact on hip-hop.

angles.name: Tupac Remembrance
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a giant. Tupac Shakur's influence on hip-hop and culture remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Remembrance
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road,' on September 26, 1969, featuring classic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun.'

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those songs... pure genius. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today, known for her distinctive voice and songwriting.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday Wish
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocks harder than anyone. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Wish
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975, following its album release in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine UK Single
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. A song that still resonates with its message of peace and unity.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people consumed music on the go.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod. Suddenly, your entire music collection fit in your pocket. Game changer.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 and over 60 years of iconic cinema. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles member and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday Wish
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eponymous double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. An incredible double LP that pushed boundaries. What's your standout track?
